title: ID0445067-DC/Si-D/NL-[RVP / T6 170004769] Payment terminal installation (HW and SW)
description:
Reported behavior/issue: During the sales phase, it was promised that Siemens could replace
the payment terminal. However, Heliox FSE lacks the necessary
expertise and training to perform this task. Despite my efforts to
engage external service providers, I’ve been unable to find a viable
solution. Heliox has ordered spare parts needed to do this job & as
recommended by johannes.jr.richter@siemens.com, this job should
be executed by SIEMENS service technician, I request help on this
task to fulfill our commitment
Notes: Connect the customer with the training team / send service team to install the payment terminal / instructions in SIOS page ->
